meta.name: farmtown_invasion
meta.prompt: A small farm town being invaded by aliens.

programs.brief: A huge alien mothership hangs low over the town, with a damaged saucer-like hull, peeled-back plates, a luminous invasion bay and landing beams aimed toward the surrounding fields; it must read as an alien flagship rather than a medieval building.
A small alien drop pod has crashed into farmland at a steep angle, surrounded by a scorched crater ring with a blown hatch and strange luminous machinery.

tokens.invasion: Aliens are invading the ordinary medieval farm town; the settlement itself is not futuristic.

root.label: the farm town beneath an alien invasion
